title: lastrea dissecta
intro: Lastrea dissecta, commonly known as the Japanese fern or Japanese variegated fern, is a species of fern in the family Athyriaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lastrea dissecta are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins that may possess anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antitumor activities. Additionally, this plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections.
